title: ruscus humilis
intro: Ruscus humilis, commonly known as Dwarf Butcher's Broom, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asparagaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and acting as a diuretic to help lower blood pressure. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiotonic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents are thought to contribute to its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
